Prerequisites: —

The engineer can sabotage an object so that it operates poorly. The engineer must succeed on a Disable Device check (DC 20) to accomplish the downgrade and sabotaging a masterwork object is slightly harder (DC 25). Noticing the engineer's handiwork without first testing the sabotaged device requires a successful Perception check (DC = the engineer's Disable Device check result). Fixing the sabotaged item requires a successful Craft check.

Sabotaging a Device: As a full-round action, the engineer can reconfigure so that anyone who uses it suffers a penalty equal to half of the engineer's level on skill checks made to use the device.
Sabotaging a Weapon: As a full-round action, the engineer can sabotage a weapon so that it has the broken condition the next time it is used. A sabotaged weapon cannot be used effectively until repaired. This use of sabotage also applies to vehicles.
